policies.title: Croatian ordinary passports: Chad electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Croatia's MFA identifies ordinary Croatian passports as visa-required for Chad, while Chad now requires new visas exclusively through its electronic platform before travel.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Croatian passport: Croatia's MFA Chad matrix says a visa is required.
Apply through Chad's official eVisa platform before travel; standard processing is 10 working days and express processing is 72 hours.
Approval, documentary, health, security, carrier and final border-admission checks remain applicable.

application.label: Chad official e-Visa platform
application.processingTime: 10 working days standard or 72 hours express.
steps: Submit the ordinary Croatian-passport visitor application online before travel.
Travel only after issuance and retain the required supporting documents.

conflicts.explanation: Croatia's MFA identifies Chad as visa-required for ordinary Croatian passports; Chad's current notices require new visas exclusively online before travel.
